about_the_game: This game features a cute doll ghost character leading players on a fantastic journey. Against a backdrop of blue skies and white clouds, players control this ghost character as it moves forward. By pressing the space bar to jump, help the character overcome various obstacles on the road, including uneven terrain and potential traps. Throughout the game, players need to stay focused, avoiding missteps and collecting as many gold coins scattered along the way as possible. The game's sound effects are dynamic, from the lively footsteps to the crisp sounds of coin collection, every detail has been meticulously crafted to provide an ultimate auditory enjoyment. Whether you're a fan of light and casual games or looking for a bit of a challenge, this game is a great choice.
